title: A commit whose KB-Work check-trailers would refuse is refused by the commit-msg hook, not only warned of
goal: kbgit.py commit-msg exits non-zero, leaving no commit, for a message whose KB-Work check-trailers refuses (a planning commit naming an item whose file it does not change), so no later step (a review's done --commit, whose evidence names the tip) builds on a commit that must be rewritten before the push. SP-vk3wf746 close: the review's parking commit named the review story in KB-Work, the hook only printed the refusal, done --commit recorded it as evidence, and the commit and the done had to be reset and run again.
notes: Merged from ST-ix5wl2lt (same check commit_msg_refuses_planning_kb_work) at the 2026-10-15 plan amendment. Its goal: kbgit.py commit-msg exits non-zero, and the commit is not made, for a backlog-planning commit whose KB-Work names an item whose file it does not change, since check-trailers refuses that commit at the push anyway (SP-7nv2ffr2 close). Its recurrences: SP-djl7za6x close, SP-htl7jkrm (2026-10-13), SP-j65ihctq retrospective. Not in the 2026-10-15 batch: turning the hook from warning to refusing reverses the documented rule that commit-msg never blocks a commit (kbgit.py, kg_hooks.hook_commit_msg), and kg_trailers.py is changed by ST-qivswoxw in SP-b36246xo; plan it after the batch with a design gate, its test check retargeted to an existing test (no new id).
